ProgramUnit.Name: GET_TEST_RESULTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
** this procedure will be used, when the test results sheet is 
** to be filled in. This routine uses following parameters
** 1. chapter_id from parameter_list
** 2. donor_id from parameter_list
** 3. unit_id from parameter_list
**
** the '-' hyphens and '/' slashes in the test id are replaced
** by 'DASH' and 'BY' in corresponding bookmark names. so we need
** to do that substitution. 
**
** The process of replacing '-', '/' and ' ' has been eliminated
** from here to get results for original Test IDs 
*/

Function get_test_results (p_test_id varchar2) return varchar2 IS
 szTestResult varchar2(30);
 szTestID varchar2(30);
 szTestID1 varchar2(32);
 szResultID unit_test_results.result_code%TYPE;
 szAbsorbance unit_test_results.absorbance%TYPE;

 cursor cur_test_result (p_testid varchar2) is
 select result_code, absorbance
 from unit_test_results
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :parameter.p_unit_id
 and coll_date = to_date( :parameter.p_last_donation_date, 'MM-DD-RR' )
 and test_id = p_testid;
-- and upper(replace(test_id, ' ')) = p_testid;

BEGIN
 if p_test_id is null then
 szTestResult := 'Invalid Test ID';
 end if;

 /*
 szTestID1 := replace(p_test_id, 'DASH', '-');
 szTestID := replace(szTestID1, 'BY', '/');
 szTestID := replace(szTestID, '&&');
 */

 open cur_test_result( p_test_id );
 fetch cur_test_result 
 into szResultID, szAbsorbance;
 IF cur_test_result%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_test_result;
 szTestResult := 'NA';
 ELSE
 If is_reactive( szResultID ) then
 szTestResult := 'POSITIVE';
 Else
 If is_unknown_result(szResultID) then
 szTestResult := 'INDETERMINATE';
 Else 
 szTestResult:= 'NEGATIVE';
 End If; 
 End If; 
 END IF;
 
 if cur_test_result%ISOPEN then
 close cur_test_result;
 end if;

 if p_test_id in ('CHOL', 'ALT') then
 -- for ALT and cholestrol values we must return the absorbance
 -- values, rather than result code. This field contains the actual
 -- numeric test result. for all other tests we use the result code for
 -- interpretation.
 szTestResult := szAbsorbance;
 end if;
 -- return the result in varchar format ('cause word likes varchar only).
-- message (p_test_id || ' -> ' || szTestID || ' -> ' || szTestResult);
 return szTestResult;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_BOOKMARKS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
/*
** this procedure will all bookmarks in the document and try to 
** get values for them. For name address etc there are two procedures
** which return appropriate value.
** for testid, we pass the bookmark name to 'get_test_results' function.
** the bookmarks for test id are based on test id itself, except that the
** '-' is replaced with 'DASH' and '/' is replaced with 'BY' in the bookmark
** name. This substtitution is done in 'get_test_results' function.
** 
** certain bookmarks are fixed, like DonorName, DonorAddress1, DonorAddress2
** sDonorName is donor name with salutation.
**
*/

procedure populate_bookmarks IS
 szPrintDate varchar2(50); -- format is MONTH DD, YYYY
 szDonorName varchar2(100);
 szSDonorName varchar2(100);
 szDonorAddress1 varchar2(100);
 szDonorAddress2 varchar2(100);
 szSignature varchar2(50); -- Person who signs the Letters
 szDonorID varchar2(10);
 szUnitID varchar2(15);
 szDonationDate varchar2(15); -- format is MM-DD-YY
 dtDonationDate date;
 szDonDate56d varchar2(15); -- format is MM-DD-YY
 szDonDate6m varchar2(15); -- format is MM-DD-YY
 szDonDate12m varchar2(15); -- format is MM-DD-YY
 szTestID varchar2(50);
 szTestResult varchar2(50);
 szABO varchar2(50);
 szTmp1 varchar2(20);

 sContent varchar2(30000);
 v_local_time date;
 v_chp_date date;

 cursor cTests is
 select test_id 
 from valid_tests_don;

BEGIN
 get_donor_name(:parameter.p_donor_id,
 szDonorName,
 szSDonorName,
 szABO);

 -- The phone nos returned are useless for us
 get_donor_address(:parameter.p_donor_id,
 szDonorAddress1,
 szDonorAddress2,
 szTmp1, -- Home
 szTmp1, -- Mobile phone if necessary for future use. Added by Kishore on 12/14/2011
 szTmp1); -- Work

 begin
 select parameter_value
 into szSignature
 from valid_parameters
 where --chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 parameter_type = 'ALL'
 and parameter_code = 'DNSUP'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate +1);
 exception
 when others then 
 show_error('18183');
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end;


 /*
 ** For every possible parameter I have to do a replace
 ** This is crude but right now there is no alternative
 */

 /*
 message( 'a ' || to_char( length( sContent )) ); pause;
 message( 'A ' || szPrintDate ); pause;
 message( 'B ' || szDonorName ); pause;
 message( 'C ' || szSDonorName ); pause;
 message( 'D ' || szDonorAddress1 ); pause;
 message( 'E ' || szDonorAddress2 ); pause;
 message( 'F ' || :parameter.p_donor_id ); pause;
 message( 'G ' || :parameter.p_unit_id ); pause;
 message( 'H ' || :parameter.p_last_donation_date ); pause;
 message( 'I ' || szABO ); pause;
 message( '1 ' || szDonDate56d ); pause;
 message( '2 ' || szDonDate6m ); pause;
 message( '3 ' || szDonDate12m ); pause;
 message( 'J ' || to_char( length( sContent )) ); pause;
 */

 -- Added on 03/08/2012; Timezone conversions code;--for IM 7174
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_chp_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_chp_date := sysdate;
 end if;

 ---------- 
 sContent := :valid_letters.letter_content;
 szPrintDate := initcap(to_char(v_chp_date, 'FMMONTH DD, YYYY'));
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&PrintDate&&', nvl( szPrintDate, ' ' ) );

 szDonorName := initcap( szDonorName );
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&DonorName&&', nvl( szDonorName, ' ' ) );

 szSDonorName := initcap( szSDonorName );
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&SDonorName&&', nvl( szSDonorName, ' ' ) );

 szDonorAddress1 := initcap( szDonorAddress1 );
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&DonorAddress1&&', nvl( szDonorAddress1, ' ' ) );

 szDonorAddress2 := szDonorAddress2;
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&DonorAddress2&&', nvl( szDonorAddress2, ' ' ) );

 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&Signature&&', nvl( szSignature, ' ' ) );

 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&DonorID&&', nvl( :parameter.p_donor_id, ' ' ) );

 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&UnitID&&', nvl( :parameter.p_unit_id, ' ' ) );

 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&DonationDate&&', nvl( :parameter.p_last_donation_date, ' ' ) );

 dtDonationDate := to_date( :parameter.p_last_donation_date, 'MM-DD-RR' );
 szDonDate56d := to_char( ( dtDonationDate + 56 ), 'MM-DD-RR' );
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&DonDate56d&&', nvl( szDonDate56d , ' ' ) );

 szDonDate6m := to_char( add_months( dtDonationDate, 6 ), 'MM-DD-RR' );
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&DonDate6m&&', nvl( szDonDate6m , ' ' ) );

 szDonDate12m := to_char( add_months( dtDonationDate, 12 ), 'MM-DD-RR' );
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&DonDate12m&&', nvl( szDonDate12m , ' ' ) );

 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&ABO&&', nvl( upper(szABO), ' ' ) );

 for crTests in cTests loop
 szTestID := crTests.test_id;
 szTestResult := get_test_results( szTestID );
 if length( szTestId ) = 1 then
 if ascii( szTestId ) > 96 and ascii( szTestId ) < 123 then
 szTestId := 'Little' || szTestId;
 end if;
 else
 szTestID := replace( szTestID, '-', 'DASH' );
 szTestID := replace( szTestID, '/', 'BY' );
 szTestID := replace( szTestID, ' ' );
 end if;
 szTestID := '&&' || upper( szTestID ) || '&&';
 sContent := replace( sContent, szTestID , nvl( ltrim( rtrim( szTestResult)), ' ' ) );
 end loop;

 :donor_letter_text.letter_text := sContent;

 if :system.cursor_item in ( 'VALID_LETTER.LETTER_CONTENT', 'DONOR_LETTER_TEXT.LETTER_TEXT' ) then
 go_item( 'ctrl_block.letter_code' );
 end if;
 
 --message('content='||get_item_property( 'valid_letters.letter_content', displayed ));pause;
 --message('text='||get_item_property( 'donor_letter_text.letter_text', displayed ));pause;
 
 if get_item_property( 'valid_letters.letter_content', displayed ) = 'TRUE' then
 set_item_property( 'valid_letters.letter_content', displayed, property_false );
 end if;
 if get_item_property( 'donor_letter_text.letter_text', displayed ) = 'FALSE' then
 set_item_property( 'donor_letter_text.letter_text', displayed, property_true );
 set_item_property( 'donor_letter_text.letter_text', enabled, property_true );
 set_item_property( 'donor_letter_text.letter_text', navigable, property_true );
 set_item_property( 'donor_letter_text.letter_text', update_allowed, property_true );
 end if;
 synchronize;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: AUTHORIZE_LETTER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
** when supervisor uses this button, authorization takes place,
** here a letter sequence number is generated and letter is saved with
** this sequence number as filename. this sequence number is stored in the 
** database tables without the '.doc' extension.
**
** An entry is made in 'donor_communications' table and 'donor_letters'
** table to indicate that donor has been notified and the status in
** 'donor_interdictions' table is set to 'NOTFY'.
**
*/

PROCEDURE authorize_letter IS
 szLetterSeqNo varchar2(10);
 szComments varchar2(1850) := null;
 szLogComment varchar2(2000) := null;
 bEditorstatus Boolean;
 szStatus varchar2(100);
 dtVerDate date;
 nCount number;
 nRtnValue number;

BEGIN
 if :parameter.p_unit_id is not null then
 select count(*)
 into nCount
 from donor_interdictions
 where chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id
 and donor_id = :parameter.p_donor_id
 and unit_id = :parameter.p_unit_id
 and inter_code != :parameter.p_inter_code
 and letter_seq_no = :parameter.p_letter_seq_no
 and notification_status = 'AUTCM';
 if nCount > 0 then
 nRtnValue := show_alert('INTER_ALERT');
 if nRtnValue = ALERT_BUTTON2 then
 access_buttons_state('INITIAL');
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_authorize', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;

 -- disable all the buttons;
 access_buttons_state('CLOSE');
 --pitss synchronize;

 -- now we show the popup to accept user comments
 show_editor('ed_comments', szcomments, szcomments, bEditorstatus);
 if NVL(length(szcomments), 0) > 0 then
 szLogComment := 'Notification: ' || :valid_letters.letter_title ||
 '. ' || chr(10) || 'Note: ' || szComments;
 else
 szLogComment := 'Notification: ' || :valid_letters.letter_title || '. ';
 end if;

 /*
 ** start with generating a letter_seq_no, this is a system generated no
 */
 
 
 create_ids('LSQ', szLetterSeqNo);
 if szLetterSeqNo is null then
 message( 'ID cannot be created' );
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 /*
 ** now we make an automatic entry in donor_communications_log table.
 ** with comm type set to 'NOTFY'
 ** comm code set to either 'PDEF' - Permenant deferral notification
 ** comm code set to either 'TDEF' - Temporary deferral notification
 ** comm code set to either 'SRVL' - Surveillance notification
 ** comm code set to either 'RFI' - Request For Information notification
 ** comm code set to either 'RENST' - Donor Reinstatement notification
 */
 begin
 -- update donor_interdictions
 update donor_interdictions
 set notification_status = 'NOTFY',
 letter_seq_no = szLetterSeqNo
 where --chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id
 DECODE(chapter_id, 'ALL', :parameter.p_chapter_id, chapter_id) = :parameter.p_chapter_id -- SCR 20752
 and donor_id = :parameter.p_donor_id
 and nvl( unit_id, '*' ) = nvl( :parameter.p_unit_id, '*' )
 and inter_code = :parameter.p_inter_code
 and letter_seq_no = :parameter.p_letter_seq_no
 and notification_status = 'AUTHZ';

/* commented by Edwin 09-11-07 SCR#2037
 if :parameter.p_unit_id is not null then
 -- update donor_interdictions for other interdiction codes
 update donor_interdictions
 set notification_status = 'CMBLT',
 letter_seq_no = szLetterSeqNo
 where chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id
 and donor_id = :parameter.p_donor_id
 and unit_id = :parameter.p_unit_id
 and inter_code != :parameter.p_inter_code
 and letter_seq_no = :parameter.p_letter_seq_no
 and notification_status = 'AUTCM';
 end if;
*/
 -- update donor_letters
 
 update donor_letters
 set letter_seq_no = szLetterSeqNo,
 authorized_by = :parameter.p_insert_user,
 authorize_date = sysdate
 where chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id
 and donor_id = :parameter.p_donor_id
 and letter_seq_no = :parameter.p_letter_seq_no;

 -- update donor_letter_text
 go_block( 'donor_letter_text' );
 :donor_letter_text.chapter_id := :parameter.p_chapter_id;
 :donor_letter_text.donor_id := :parameter.p_donor_id;
 :donor_letter_text.letter_seq_no := szLetterSeqNo;

 
/*
 clear_block( no_validate);
 update donor_letter_text
 set letter_seq_no = szLetterSeqNo
 where chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id
 and donor_id = :parameter.p_donor_id
 and letter_seq_no = :parameter.p_letter_seq_no;
*/
 -- make an entry into donor_communications
 Begin 
 insert into donor_communications
 (DONOR_ID, COM_CODE, COM_DATE,
 PROGRAM_ID, INSERT_DATE, INSERT_USER,
 CHAPTER_ID, COM_TYPE, COM_DESC,
 ACTION_DATE, LETTER_ID)
 VALUES
 (:parameter.p_donor_id, :parameter.p_letter_id, sysdate,
 'DNWSNDLT', sysdate, :parameter.p_insert_user,
 :parameter.p_chapter_id, 'NOTFY',
 substr(szlogcomment, 1, 2000), -- we take only first 2000 characters
 --sysdate, -- action date -- IM 11 (LT2013R3)
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:parameter.p_chapter_id, sysdate),-- action date -- IM 11 (LT2013R3)
 szLetterSeqNo);
 Exception when others then 
 message(sqlerrm);pause;
 End ;
 

-- exception
-- when others then
-- show_error('18105');
-- exit_form(no_validate);

 commit_form;

 -- generate letter report/ file
 begin
 select version_date
 into dtVerDate
 from valid_letters
 where letter_code = :ctrl_block.letter_code
 and version_no = (select max( a.version_no )
 from valid_letters a
 where a.letter_code = :ctrl_block.letter_code );
 exception
 when others then
 null;
 end;
 run_letter_report ('dnrlettr',
 :parameter.p_chapter_id,
 :parameter.p_donor_id,
 szLetterSeqNo,
 :ctrl_block.letter_code,
 to_char( dtVerDate, 'MM-DD-YY' ),
 szStatus );

 if szStatus != 'OK' then
 message( szStatus ); pause;
 end if;
 clear_message;
 show_error('18113');
 synchronize;
 :global.cur_donor_status := 'NOTIFY'; 
 end;
END;

 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 v_return varchar2(300) :=Null;

 szWPhoneNumber varchar2(20) := null;
Begin

 select intl_address_1||decode(intl_address_2,nvl(intl_address_2,0),',',null)||' '||
 intl_address_2||decode(intl_address_3,nvl(intl_address_3,0),',',null)||' '||
 intl_address_3||decode(intl_address_4,nvl(intl_address_4,0),',',null)||' '||
 intl_address_4||decode(country_name,nvl(country_name,0),',',null)||' '||
 COUNTRY_NAME||decode(intl_postal_code,nvl(intl_postal_code,0),',',null)||' '||INTL_POSTAL_CODE, 
 intl_home_phone_no, intl_work_phone_no, intl_work_phone_ext 
 Into szAddress, szHPhoneNumber, szWPhoneNumber,szExtension
 from donor_addresses 
 where donor_id = szDonorID
 and chapter_id = szChapterID 
 and address_type = 'RES'
 and intl_addr_flag = 'Y';

 
 if p_what = 'ADDR' then

 Return v_return;
 
Exception when others then handle_error;
